title: Normal Ultrasound Examination
guideline: No masses, architectural distortion, or suspicious calcifications are detected. Routine age-appropriate screening is recommended.

title: Definitively Benign Lesion
guideline: Findings include simple anechoic cyst with posterior acoustic enhancement or typical benign intramammary lymph node. Zero risk of malignancy (<0%).
action: Routine annual screening. No intervention or biopsy needed.

title: Probably Benign Lesion (<2% Malignancy Risk)
guideline: Solid mass with circumscribed margins, oval shape, and parallel orientation (wider than tall), most commonly fibroadenoma. Malignancy probability is <= 2%.
action: Short-interval 6-month unilateral follow-up ultrasound to demonstrate stability over 24-36 months.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5th Edition / NCCN Breast Guidelines
title: Low Suspicion of Malignancy (>2% to <=10%)
guideline: Lesion with low-to-moderate suspicion, such as an atypical complicated cyst or probable fibroadenoma with partially obscured or gently microlobulated margins.
action: Ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy (CNB) recommended; patient counseling.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5th Edition / NCCN Guidelines
title: Moderate Suspicion of Malignancy (>10% to <=50%)
guideline: Solid lesion with indistinct margins or non-parallel orientation without definite spiculation. Malignancy risk spans 10% to 50%.
action: Core needle biopsy is strongly recommended with pathology concordance review.

title: High Suspicion of Malignancy (>50% to <95%)
guideline: Irregular hypoechoic mass with angular margins and posterior acoustic shadowing, highly concerning for invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC).
action: Immediate core needle biopsy and surgical/oncology multidisciplinary consultation.

source: ACR BI-RADS Atlas 5th Edition / Society of Breast Imaging
title: Classic Malignant Presentation (>=95% Probability)
guideline: Classic presentation: Spiculated margins, taller-than-wide (non-parallel) orientation, hypoechoic with acoustic shadowing, microcalcifications. Malignancy risk exceeds 95%.
action: Urgent tissue biopsy and referral to surgical oncology for staging and treatment planning.
